list.name: List
list.purpose: Render repeated records for scan-first processes before tabular comparison is required.

anatomy.rule: Owns row rhythm, separators, and bounded surface.
Carries one readable or actionable record; use a button only when the row acts or navigates.
Supports record type without replacing the label.
Name the record and add short secondary context.
Optional aligned amount, count, or status value.

list.statePrecedence: disabled > loading > error > selected > hover > default

Energy.decision: Use semantic row, icon, value, action, and danger colors without replacing primary tokens from the ZIP.
Energy.behavior: Rows remain readable and states are not color-only.
Energy.rejectIf: Raw colors or ZIP colors override Flow semantics.

Voice.decision: Use concise row labels and metadata.

Frame.decision: Use stable row spacing, density, width, separators, and target size.
Frame.behavior: Rows align in sheets and panels.

Depth.decision: Use container separation only; rows do not become individual cards.

Momentum.decision: Use tokenized hover, focus, and selection motion.
Momentum.behavior: Row feedback is quick and reduced-motion friendly.

State.decision: Disabled and loading resolve above error, selected, and hover.

Tone.decision: Use tone only for status rows with visible text or metadata.

Growth.decision: Escalate to Table when comparison, columns, sorting, or bulk actions are required.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System symbol sizes and boxed icon alignment.
Iconography.behavior: Icons align optically with labels and density.

Accessibility.decision: Use list semantics and row controls only when interactive.

props.name: state
props.type: default | hover | selected | loading | error | disabled
props.notes: List-wide demo or fallback row state.

props.name: density
props.notes: Row density: sm, md, or lg.

props.name: onSelect
props.notes: Called when an interactive row is selected.

agentInstructions: Use List for scan-first repeated records.
Ask before row actions change critical data.
Escalate to Table when columns or bulk actions are needed.
